free_tier.stated: 个人标准版·Free: free; a one-time grant of 5,000 points on first registration, valid 7 days; code completion free; when the grant is spent the CLI falls back to an Auto free mode with a daily limit whose number is not published
free_tier.notes: points are spent as tokens times the model's unit price, so request-count is the nearest metered_on term. A second render of the pricing page states the first-registration gift as CNY 10 of model quota instead of 5,000 points. Pro is CNY 59 a month on comate.baidu.com with 25,000 points a month and an Auto-Free fallback of 150k tokens an hour once points run out; the Baidu Cloud price list states Pro at CNY 70 a month, CNY 210 a quarter or CNY 840 a year. Max is CNY 199 a month with 100,000 points and 500k tokens an hour.

interface_detail: ComateCLI (`comatecli`) runs as a TUI or headless with `comatecli run -q`, writes the result to stdout and exits 0 or 1; `-d task-json` gives structured output. Login is a device code (`comatecli login`, `--no-browser` on SSH) or a license passed per command with `-l`. IDE plugins and a Comate IDE are the other surfaces
tooling: ComateCLI from npm (`npm i -g @comate/comatecli`, Node.js 20.10 or later); IDE plugins
chaining: the Auto free mode keeps the CLI usable after the 7-day grant, and the official model list (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax) is billed in points at per-token prices, so the free plan is a fallback leg rather than a primary agent quota

limits.value: 5,000 points once on first registration, valid 7 days; then an Auto free mode with a daily limit whose number is not published
Pro (CNY 59 a month on the site, CNY 70 list): 25,000 points a month, then the Auto-Free mode at 150k tokens an hour; Max (CNY 199): 100,000 points, then 500k tokens an hour

binding_note: the one-time grant lasts 7 days, after which only the unnumbered daily Auto free mode remains on the free plan; on Pro the 150k tokens an hour fallback binds once the monthly points are spent

identity_cost.detail: Comate signs in with a Baidu account or a license; a Baidu account is created with a mobile number, and sign-in through WeChat, Weibo, QQ, GitHub or Gitee re-verifies and binds a mobile number for account real-name rules. The default Baidu registration form has no calling-code selector; the overseas registration form lists mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, US/Canada, UK, Switzerland, Norway, Russia/Kazakhstan, Japan, India and other countries, and names no EU member state. A third party reports that numbers from EU member states are refused and that an account registered with an overseas number works on other Baidu products; whether such an account signs in to Comate is unverified behind a sign-up. Paid plans on comate.baidu.com are paid with Alipay
identity_cost.country: CN, or a country on the Baidu overseas registration list (US/Canada, UK, Japan, India and others; no EU member state)

reliability_note: the vendor cut Pro's unlimited fallback model to 150k tokens an hour from 2026-07-01
confidence_note: the prices, the point grants, the fallback rates, the headless CLI and the mobile-number requirement are quoted from first-party pages read. Whether a non-Chinese mobile number registers today and the size of the free Auto mode's daily limit sit behind a sign-up and are unverified.

A third-party tracker reads the Auto-Free fallback as a paid-plan benefit only; the CLI documentation states a daily-limited Auto free mode after the gift runs out.
